item.title: Pysanky Egg-Making Classes Announced by the Schuylkill County Historical Society
item.description: Renowned folk artist Georgine Postupak-Borchick will lead two hands-on Pysanky Egg Workshops on Saturday, March 7 and Saturday, March 14 at 10:00 am at the Schuylkill County Historical Society, 305 N. Centre St., Pottsville. The fee is $30 for Society members and $35 for nonmembers. Registration is required, please contact the Society at 570-622-7540 or visit Schuylkillhistory.org.

item.title: Update: Shenandoah Without Water Service; Leak Still Not Located
item.description: Shenandoah Borough officials provided an update early Tuesday morning, February 17, confirming that the town is currently without water service as crews continue working to locate a leak within the system. According to borough officials, Aqua Pennsylvania, Inc. shut down the water treatment plant Monday evening after a significant loss of pressure in the system.
